hyperedges.label: Runtime version resolution of Moodle stack
Safe Moodle upgrade flow (maintenance, backup, upgrade, rollback)

nodes.label: Backup to /var/backups/moodle
nodes.rationale: Database and code backed up before Moodle changes; newest 3 kept; course files excluded, so rely on Proxmox backups.

nodes.label: Upgrade Rollback
nodes.rationale: If the Moodle upgrade fails, previous code and database are restored.

nodes.label: Summary Screen Before Creation
nodes.rationale: Shows everything before anything is created; Exit at any step changes nothing, so aborting is safe.

nodes.label: MariaDB
nodes.rationale: Release's minimum from environment.xml (11.4 for 5.3), from MariaDB's repository.

nodes.label: PHP
nodes.rationale: Newest PHP the Moodle release supports, from release notes (8.4 for 5.3).

nodes.label: Major Version Upgrade
nodes.rationale: Major versions (e.g. 5.3 -> 5.4) need a separate yes because they bring new PHP and MariaDB requirements.

nodes.label: Offline Fallback Versions
nodes.rationale: Without internet access to version sources it falls back to Moodle 5.3, PHP 8.4, MariaDB 11.4.

nodes.label: Manual update install for older containers
